targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (topic)
  timestamp            AS time,
  topic                AS topic,
  watt_ac_compressor_1 AS watt_compressor_1,
  watt_ac_compressor_2 AS watt_compressor_2,
  watt_sea_water_pump  AS watt_sea_water_pump
FROM public.termodinamica__ac_misc
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY topic, timestamp DESC

SELECT
  timestamp            AS time,
  topic                AS topic,
  watt_ac_compressor_1 AS watt_compressor_1
FROM public.termodinamica__ac_misc
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY topic

SELECT
  timestamp            AS time,
  topic                AS topic,
  watt_ac_compressor_2 AS watt_compressor_2
FROM public.termodinamica__ac_misc
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY topic

SELECT
  timestamp           AS time,
  topic               AS topic,
  watt_sea_water_pump AS watt_sea_water_pump

ORDER BY topic

SELECT DISTINCT ON (topic)
  timestamp   AS time,
  topic       AS topic,
  pwr         AS on_off,
  heater_pwr  AS heater_on_off,
  fan_speed   AS fan_speed,
  sp_room     AS temperature_setpoint,
  air_in      AS temperature,
  humi        AS humitidy,
  status      AS status
FROM public.termodinamica__ac
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY topic, timestamp DESC
